name: flow
description: Fracture-flow network items: 'flowplane' (the planar flow domain on joints — contour/label, cracked), 'fknot' (flow knots/nodes — contour pore pressure/head), and 'fblock' (flow blocks). Colour by domain attributes via 'colorby' / 'contour'. Used for hydro-mechanical (joint flow) analyses.
notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.
flowplane top-level: active, clip, color-list, colorby, contour, cracked, cut, cut-line, label, legend, polygons, range, transparency.
fknot top-level: active, clip, color-by-value, color-list, colorby, contour, contourby, cut, legend, map, mark, pixel-size, range, scale, transparency.
fblock top-level: active, axis, clip, color-list, colorby, cut, legend, polygons, range, rotate, scale, translate, transparency, value.
fblock top-level keywords: active, axis, clip, color-list, colorby, cut, legend, polygons, range, rotate, scale, translate, transparency, value
fknot top-level keywords: active, clip, color-by-value, color-list, colorby, contour, contourby, cut, legend, map, mark, pixel-size, range, scale, transparency
flowplane top-level keywords: active, clip, color-list, colorby, contour, cracked, cut, cut-line, label, legend, polygons, range, transparency
flowplane-vector top-level keywords: active, by-magnitude, clip, color, cut, draw-as, legend, map, point-to-base, quality, range, scale, shape, transparency, value

The previous shared top_level_keywords list was the UNION of the three types; live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumerates distinct sets per type (fblock has no contour/map; fknot adds contourby/color-by-value; flowplane adds cracked/cut-line/label). 'fplane' is a live twin of flowplane with the same keyword set. Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Colour entities by a scalar/vector/tensor field attribute. See sub-item 'contour'.
keywords.name: contour

keywords.description: Categorical colour entities by an attribute (group, type, state, ...). See sub-item 'colorby'.
keywords.name: colorby

keywords.description: Restrict drawing to cracked (failed) joint segments.
keywords.name: cracked

keywords.description: Draw filled polygons (faces) rather than wireframe.
keywords.name: polygons

keywords.description: Filter which entities are drawn using range elements (see references/range-elements).
keywords.name: range

keywords.description: Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).
keywords.name: transparency

examples.command: plot item create flowplane contour legend active on
examples.description: Contour the joint flow plane field. Use case: Flowplane pore pressure

examples.command: plot item create fknot contour legend active on
examples.description: Colour flow knots by head/pressure. Use case: Flow knots
